review.imagery: Eleven project renders were visually reviewed. Eight native brochure scenes cover two complete building exteriors, evening facade, office lobby, pool terrace, reception concept, workspace and dining terrace. Three distinct current-gallery scenes add retail frontage, facade detail and amenity aerial. The 7973-pixel wide frontage supplies the card and hero. Generic office/business/retail photographs and sliced lifestyle collages are excluded. Proposed fitout remains unit-unspecific. No dated construction photos or card badges.
review.floorPlans: Nine complete building sheets cover ground-floor retail, first-floor retail and amenities, and offices on floors 2–8. Individual unit areas are absent. The upper sheets retain the source’s Retail Type heading above an Office legend. Confirm unit boundaries, contractual area and approved fitout with SAMANA. All nine complete physical plan-pack pages 2–10 were individually reviewed. Ground and first floors show retail and shared facilities. Upper sheets identify offices in both labels and their legend, while retaining the copied Retail Type heading. No individual unit drawing or numeric schedule is published in this pack. Primary 598 sq ft office / 552 sq ft retail minimums are not assigned to a particular floorplate.
review.location: Complete original brochure pages 7–8 were visually reviewed. The map’s red marker supplies regional context. Primary travel groups differ from brochure and fact-sheet estimates. The saved source-hashed map receipt records the official name-only q query Samana Business Park. No camera centre, nearby project coordinate, road distance or exact visitor entrance is inferred.
review.provenance: Fresh primary HTML, original developer brochure, fact sheet and original floor-plan pack retain receipts, original bytes and SHA-256 values. Native image origins, whole sheets and individual physical PDF links remain available. Protected ownership, completed commercial research and source differences are preserved.

unavailable: Individual unit drawings, drawing-specific numerical areas, approved unit fitout, a reliable project/entrance coordinate and dated construction photographs were not established. Source travel estimates and floorplate headings retain their qualifications.
